errors.text_span: Most blocks from the beginning through the high-50s are shown as green (2-Fbit) bars
errors.evidence: This statement over-simplifies the pattern of bars for block indices 0 through 58. While the majority of these bars are indeed green, the chart shows a distinct pattern of a green segment (indices 0 to ~44), followed by a blue segment (indices ~45 to ~50), which is then followed by another green segment (indices ~51 to 58). Lumping the two distinct green segments into one general statement obscures this clear alternating structure.

errors.text_span: (near the lower end of the \(10^{-5}\) decade)
errors.evidence: The blue bars in the middle of the chart (e.g., at indices 45, 50, 56) have values below 10^-5, placing them in the 10^-6 decade ([10^-6, 10^-5)). The description incorrectly states they are near the lower end of the 10^-5 decade, which is the range [10^-5, 10^-4). The correct description would be that they are near the upper end of the 10^-6 decade, or approaching the value 10^-5.
